title: One reviewer's critique of a draft plan

summary.description: Whether this plan, executed as written, produces what goal.md says done looks like.

severity.description: blocking: the plan cannot be executed, or does not deliver the goal. major: it will produce the wrong thing somewhere. minor: worth fixing while revising.

where.description: The deliverable number or plan section this is about.

detail.description: Grounded in the repository or in goal.md. A critique that cites neither is an opinion about software in general.

remedy.description: What the revision should do. Say 'say less about X' when the defect is over-specification: a plan can fail by carrying detail a competent implementer would read out of the repository.
